title: On-Site Inspecting Zombie Lending
eligible_reason: Triple-difference (Inspected x Zombie x Post) with firm x quarter, bank x quarter and firm x bank FE, estimated separately for each of two inspection episodes (sectoral mid-2012; general mid-2013), each with one adoption date, plus a continuous-exposure industry-level regression.
design_notes: Eq. (1): NewLoan_fbt = a_ft + a_bt + a_bf + b*(Inspected_b x Zombie_f x Post_t) + e_fbt, 4 quarters before/after, inspection quarters dropped, clustered by bank-year-quarter. Less saturated models in the main tables include the lower-order terms Inspected x Post and Zombie x Post. Dynamic version replaces Post by quarter dummies. Table 10: industry-level regression of 2012-14 changes on a standardized continuous Industry exposure. Each regression has one adoption date; treatment is a triple interaction; extra non-redundant FE.
main_or_robustness: main (but triple-difference, single date per regression)
screener_notes: Not eligible: triple-difference with subgroup-by-treatment interaction, extra FE, single date per estimation sample, continuous exposure in industry regressions. No replication package was listed in the batch file (package_dir and regressions_path empty); screening is from the article text only. Data: Portuguese Central Credit Register (Banco de Portugal), confidential.
